homepageTagline: Advancing Agentic Intelligence, Multi-Agent Collaboration, and LLM-Driven Systems
homepageIntro: AAIL explores the foundations of autonomous agents, emergent collaboration, and robust reasoning. We build systems that blend learning with decision-making, bridging theory and practice across language, vision, planning, and multi-agent environments.
investigateLead: From grounded agents to scalable language models, we design architectures that reason, coordinate, and adapt. Our work spans algorithmic research and system-building, with collaborative projects across academia and industry.
cardAgenticDesc: Planning, safety, and adaptive decision-making under uncertainty.
cardMultiDesc: Coordination, negotiation, and emergent behaviors in complex settings.
cardLLMDesc: Tool use, retrieval-augmented reasoning, and grounded interaction.
cardResponsibleDesc: Robustness, evaluation, and human-centered deployment practices.
